title: Rav Chama bar Buzi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (In Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim: bar Bizna.) He was Rava’s student, as in Bava Batra 16b: Ravina and Rav Chama bar Buzi were sitting before Rava, and Rava was dozing. Ravina said to him: “Is it certain that you say (in Rabbi Yochanan’s name), ‘Every death…’?” etc. He said, “Yes.” Meanwhile Rava woke up and said to them: “Children, thus said Rabbi Yochanan,” etc. In Berakhot 50a Ravina and Rav Chama bar Buzi came to the Exilarch’s house; Rav Chama rose and was looking for [a group of] a hundred. Ravina said to him: “You need not; thus said Rava,” etc.

notes.text: The final “you need not” is made explicit as Ravina addressing Rav Chama, following the connected pair of actors. The Buzi/Bizna difference and the quoted Rabbi Yochanan attribution remain.
The inspected Berakhot 50a calls him Chama bar Buzi and has Ravina tell him that he need not seek a hundred. The exact Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim Bizna readings remain Hyman’s reports.
